Suggested crop rotation

Only crops listed as suitable in a favourable environment are considered. The top three per season are ranked with a 0–100 score: gross margin (Tk/decimal) 40%, BCR on variable costs 30%, and BCR on total costs 30%, normalized against crops in the same location and season. In saline upazilas, non-saline-tolerant crops receive a 30% penalty. In flood-signal upazilas, crops without a submergence-tolerant listing receive a 15% penalty for unknown-permanent-water signals or 25% for possible inundation. Matching tolerance listings avoid that penalty. Missing economic values use the location-season median, or same-season overall median only when that location-season has no reported values. These judgment-based weights produce comparative suggestions, not a farm-specific guarantee.
